93:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're coming on strong for a first meeting.」

93:t_10:9.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Am I? Sorry to disappoint you, but that's the kind of man I am.」

93:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...$$ニコラ$$. I am curious about the fear behind all that confidence and freewheeling behavior.」

93:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That heartfelt murmur when you defeated a space monster with your $$トップレス$$ power... It produced some fine $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

93:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「50 Z, to be precise... I'll add that to the unit's reserves.」

93:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, $$ニコラ$$... I won't pry into what frightens you, but I hope you'll produce more $$Ｚチップ$$s for us.」

93:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a pleasure, $$ノノ$$. I'm $$ＡＧ$$, an agent robot for $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$.」

93:t_10:21.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you for introducing yourself so promptly. This $$ノノ$$... was born on Mars...」

93:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... You can skip the ceremonial introduction. Despite appearances, I'm quite busy myself.」

93:t_10:23.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ told me about your work, $$ＡＧ$$. Please let this $$ノノ$$ help you.」

93:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Are you sure? I thought the housekeeping team would suit you better, $$ノノ$$...」

93:t_10:25.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well... I already... broke the automatic cooker...」

93:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You mean you got fired!? On your first day!?」

93:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. As a fellow robot, this $$ＡＧ$$ will hire you, $$ノノ$$.」

93:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. With a cute girl as our shop's face, we should attract more customers.」

93:t_10:31.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Understood! This humble $$ノノ$$ will give it her all with effort and guts!」

93:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then here we go! Let's get to work today...」

94:t_000:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「...We haven't encountered $$サイデリアル$$ so far.」

94:t_000:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「Perhaps their main force has moved to $$蒼の地球$$.」

94:t_000:2.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「Have they lost interest in $$翠の地球$$?」

94:t_000:3.en:
$$モニカ$$
「If what $$バルビエル$$ said is true.」

94:t_000:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「But it's such a beautiful planet...」

94:t_000:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Still, $$ロラン$$ said that $$翠の地球$$'s natural environment was once destroyed.」

94:t_000:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Apparently, it took a long time for the environment to recover to its present state.」

94:t_000:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「A lost environment recovering over many years... I hear the world of the $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet was much the same.」

94:t_000:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But to $$サイデリアル$$, Earth likely has value only as a key to drawing out $$次元力$$.」

94:t_000:10.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Is something wrong, Captain?」

94:t_000:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We did liberate $$翠の地球$$ and gather new forces...」

94:t_000:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But we certainly cannot call it a victory. We're reacting to $$サイデリアル$$ at every turn.」

94:t_000:13.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The fighting ahead will be difficult, too.」

94:t_000:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We must strike $$ラース・バビロン$$ and settle this before it's too late...」

94:t_001:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I've detected a force approaching us...!」

94:t_001:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is it $$サイデリアル$$...!?」

94:t_002:0.en:
$$ボビー$$
「What is this mishmash of units...!?」

94:t_002:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「There are no life signs in the enemy machines!」

94:t_002:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Are they the ones we've fought before?」

94:t_002:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, launch. We will intercept the enemy.」

94:t_003:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's that unidentified robot army again!」

94:t_003:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Look, $$正太郎$$! They've got robots from $$ギシン星$$ and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, too!」

94:t_003:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So they are connected to $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$...」

94:t_003:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「We'll figure that out later! First, we knock down anyone coming at us!」

94:t_003:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「No. We can count on him.」

94:t_004:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Just call me $$ランド$$. I'm counting on you, $n.」

94:t_004:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「I thought getting beaten by $$バルビエル$$ was still bothering him, but he seems fine.」

94:t_004:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you combined that man's overbearing smile with $n and divided by two, you'd have a good balance.」

94:t_004:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'd recommend throwing yourself into that mix, too.」

94:t_005:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We don't know who the enemy is, but since they're attacking us, we have to intercept them.」

94:t_005:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Wait, Captain! Another force is entering this area!」

94:t_006:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I never get tired of hearing that wonderful name.」

94:t_006:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「Are those the people you met on Earth?」

94:t_006:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Yes. They're quite capable by this world's standards.」

94:t_006:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「So what now? It's just until our real target arrives, but should we contact them and...」

94:t_006:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「No, first I'd like to test them. ...All right, Princess?」

94:t_006:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If that's what you've decided, $$ニコラ$$.」

94:t_006:8.en:
$$チコ$$
(Oh, please... What does she see in a man like that...?)

94:t_006:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$トップレス$$ pilots, please respond. I am Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$, captain of $c's $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」

94:t_006:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$c... So that's what you're called.」

94:t_006:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We are currently engaging an unidentified force. They will probably attack indiscriminately.」

94:t_006:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I propose we cooperate to handle them.」

94:t_006:13.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you for the advice. But we'll do things our own way.」

94:t_006:14.en:
$$クラン$$
「What's his problem!? We're just trying to help!」

94:t_006:15.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Do they have a reason they can't fight alongside us...? Or are they that confident...?」

94:t_006:16.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Let's go, Princess, $$チコ$$. Let's show them our power.」

94:t_006:17.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Um... $$ニコラ$$... $$ノノ$$ is here too...」

94:t_006:18.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're supporting me, $$ノノ$$. You don't need to move to the front.」
